The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative. Ďurech2007 is the actual published collaboration-network shape source. Hanuš2018 TableA.3 uses its pole(95,68), period3.96820 h, QF3 and VS-TPM volume-equivalent diameter51.1±2.1 km. Only this uniform size transfer is applied to nominal DAMIT157. The alternative pole(280,74) has its own50.1±1.3 km fit and remains possible; the varied-model ensemble does not establish byte-identical local terrain.
